authContext.note: No auth guard found in this route, its (app) layout (AppShell), or content.ts/getContent. useSession() is called only to read `user?.wawuId`/`user?.fullName` for optimistically labeling a just-posted comment as by the current user (isCreator check, display name fallback to 'You') — the screen never checks isAuthenticated or redirects when user is null. initiateUnlock/verifyUnlock are called with `authed: true` in content.ts (attaches a bearer token IF one exists in sessionStorage), but the UI itself performs no pre-check and would let a logged-out session attempt the unlock flow. creatorGates() is not imported or referenced anywhere in this screen — no Creator-account gating logic applies to content-detail.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: content === null && error === null, i.e. between mount/param-change and getContent(id) resolving — renders DetailSkeleton

getContent(id) rejects — either mockContentById(id) returns null ('Content not found') or apiFetch throws in a real-backend build — caught in load()'s .catch and rendered as ErrorState with a Retry that re-calls load()
content.accessType === "free" (derived `state` variable) — full engagement row, no lock veil, no CTA/unlock panel
content.accessType === "paid" && content.purchased === false — shows lock veil/preview cut-line, hides live engagement actions (share/save/rate), shows LockedCta with 'Unlock for ₦X' button

content.accessType === "paid" && content.purchased === true (either seeded that way by mockPurchasedIds, or flipped client-side after a successful verifyUnlock) — shows 'Yours' pill, UnlockedActions (download/tip), live engagement row
unlockOpen is set true (user tapped Unlock) and payment state reset to "idle" — shows price, split-in-naira, and Pay button
after initiateUnlock() resolves, payment is set to "processing" while a 2400ms mock timer stands in for bank confirmation

the mock timer's `paid` boolean resolves true (hardcoded, always true in mock) AND verifyUnlock's response has data.purchased === true (also hardcoded true in mock) — content is patched to purchased:true, fullAssetLocked:false

code path exists for: (a) the mock `paid` promise resolving false, or (b) verifyUnlock's response having data.purchased === false, or (c) initiateUnlock/verifyUnlock throwing (caught by the outer try/catch)
uiStatesHandled.note: In the current mock layer this state is DEAD CODE at the data-flow level for the two 'declined' paths: the mock `paid` promise in page.tsx is hardcoded to always resolve(true) (no branch ever produces false), and content.ts's mock verifyUnlock always returns { purchased: true, ... } with no failure branch. The only way to reach payment=failure today is an actual thrown exception (e.g. a real misconfigured/unreachable backend once NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is set) — there is no dev-only toggle for it on this screen (unlike CreatorOnboarding.tsx's STUB-4 simulate-failure button), so this designed state (frame 4c in the .dc.html) currently has NO reachable trigger in a pure-mock build.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: content is loaded; always rendered under EngagementRow — comments seeded from mockComments (3 hardcoded entries), locally appended to on submit
downloadAsset() called with a falsy url (fullAssetUrl undefined) — shows 'No downloadable file is attached to this piece yet.' for 2.2s
uiStatesHandled.note: reachable whenever a purchased/free piece happens to have no fullAssetUrl in its data, or if download is somehow triggered while still locked

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: downloadAsset() called with a truthy url — triggers a synthetic <a download> click and shows 'Download started' for 2.2s
navigator.share is unavailable/unsupported (or user dismisses it) and navigator.clipboard.writeText succeeds — shows a 'Copied'/checkmark state for 1.6s
user taps the Rate pill in EngagementRow — opens a 1–5 star picker; selecting a star sets local myRating and closes the sheet with no network call

uiStatesDesigned.state: Free — plays in full, engagement row live
Locked — real preview then a labelled cut line (image/video/pdf lock veil)
Locked course — gated at the episode (lesson list with free lesson 1, locked 2+)
Unlock sheet — idle, price and split stated in naira
Unlock sheet — processing ('Confirming with your bank')
Unlock sheet — success ('Unlocked', Start reading / Download the file)
Unlock sheet — failed ('Payment did not go through', Try again / Use another method)
Unlocked — quiet 'Yours' chip, download + tip actions
Comments — existing thread restyled, composer pinned to bottom
